edges.reason: msg.sender drives payment, whitelist accounting and recipient checks in mint.
tx.origin is used as an 'Only EOA' gate, which is bypassable via a malicious intermediary contract.
mint performs an external gold.burn call before finishing its own state updates, exposing an external control transfer.
mint invokes the external GTG.mint inside the minting loop, handing control to another contract.
mint calls the external mines.addTokensToStake after minting, another external control transfer point.
selectRecipient calls back into the external mines contract to obtain a random goblin owner during minting.
mint calls selectRecipient to determine the token recipient.
selectRecipient uses getSomeRandomNumber to decide whether to steal the token.
getTokenToBeMinted uses getSomeRandomNumber to pick an index into _availableTokens.
mint calls getTokenToBeMinted for each minted token.
mint calls updateRandomIndex for phases other than 1.
getSomeRandomNumber derives its output from blockhash, block.coinbase, block.difficulty and msg.sender.
withdraw performs a native value transfer of the balance to the owner.
mint calls mintPrice to compute and validate the required payment.
The _amount parameter bounds the mint loop and payment computation.
_amount is multiplied by phasePrice in mintPrice, an unchecked user-influenced arithmetic path.
The _stake parameter decides whether tokens are routed to mines for staking.
The _seed parameter is abi.encoded into the randomness hash.
The _limit parameter is used as the modulus (random % _limit), risking division by zero.
The minted local feeds the max supply requirement check.
The maxTokens local feeds the max supply requirement check.
totalGoldCost is the amount passed to the external gold.burn call.
tokenIds is the array forwarded to mines.addTokensToStake.
tokenId is forwarded to the external GTG.mint call.
The block based randomness output is assigned to the random local.
The current phase selects the payment branch and recipient logic in mint.
phasePrice[phase] is the unit price used by mintPrice.
_whitelistAddresses gates presale minting and is mutated by mint.
The gold contract is queried for balances and used for burning in mint.
The GTG contract supplies supply counters and receives mint calls from mint.
_availableTokens is read and mutated (swap-and-pop) by getTokenToBeMinted.
_randomIndex selects the random source used in the hash.
_randomSource balances are summed into the extra entropy term.
hasPublicSaleStarted decides between public and whitelist-only presale minting.
_randomCalls is mixed into the randomness hash.
The mines contract provides the random goblin owner used by selectRecipient.
The owner address receives the withdrawn balance and gates withdraw via onlyOwner.
paused() returns the _paused state used by the whenNotPaused modifier on mint.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller supplied amount is only meaningful inside the mint entry point that validates and consumes it.
Stake flag only influences the mint loop and whether mines.addTokensToStake is invoked.
Seed parameter is consumed solely by the randomness hashing inside getSomeRandomNumber.
Limit parameter is consumed solely as the modulus inside getSomeRandomNumber.
Local supply snapshot exists only for the supply check in mint.
Local max supply snapshot exists only for the supply check in mint.
Local cost value is directly consumed as the amount argument of the external gold.burn call.
Local token id array is directly forwarded to the external staking call.
Local recipient value is directly passed as the recipient argument of the external GTG.mint call.
Local token id value is directly passed as the tokenId argument of the external GTG.mint call.
Local hash result is only used to produce the return value of getSomeRandomNumber.
Local balance accumulator only feeds the randomness hash inside getSomeRandomNumber.
